body:
### Downloads #### Y1 · Type A

#### Y1 · Type B

--- Since v0.5 most work went into stability updates and merging upstream updates into this fork to keep it up-to-date. Fork specific changes: - Various plugin bug fixes - Plugin to turn off the internal speaker (by @Ferrhat) - Better support for AirPods (by @Semy0nBu) - Switching between Rockbox and Stock (well, a modified better-Y by @Leska1337) without reboot - Many new themes! Check them out here: https://github.com/rockbox-y1/themes/releases/tag/for_the_gays_and_the_theys My work will now fully focus on bringing this fork closer to upstream Rockbox by removing most custom features from the Rockbox code and moving them into a dedicated settings menu. This also means the external apps launcher will come back (and many new things). If you want to support this project financially, please send your kindness to Partners in Health to fight child mortality in impoverished communities: https://www.pih.org/maternal-center-excellence

name: Portable Flashing Package: Rockbox-Y1 v0.5
body:
### Downloads #### Y1 · Type A

#### Y1 · Type B

--- As a preparation for eventually submitting this port to the upstream Rockbox project a lot had to change under the hood. For now this means the removal of very specific and rarely used features like the Apps menu. It also means simpler merges of new upstream features. 360p only, there won't be any future 240p releases. If you have issues, try these steps: 1. Full flash of the new ROM. 2. Delete `.rockbox` on your SD card, this should fix any weird path issues you might encounter (especially shortcuts) 3. Themes have been updated, see here: https://github.com/rockbox-y1/themes/releases/tag/for_the_gays_and_the_theys 4. If you want to use any custom themes that worked for older Rockbox-Y1 versions, you will need to change paths in the theme files from `/.rockbox` to `/sdcard/.rockbox` 5. Install font pack: https://download.rockbox.org/release/4.0/rockbox-fonts-4.0.zip New: - Discontinuation of the 240p versions - Updated stock app - Support for devices that came with stock firmware 3.0.7 - Black screen bug mitigations - Fixes plugins as start screen - Fixes audio not pausing on BT disconnect - Minor fixes (scrobble upload)

name: Portable Flashing Package: Rockbox-Y1 v0.4
body:
### Downloads #### Y1 · 240p

#### Y1 · 360p

--- New Features: - Extend lastfm_scrobbler plugin to [upload directly to Last.fm + ListenBrainz](https://github.com/rockbox-y1/rockbox/blob/y1/INTERNET.md#scrobbling-lastfm-listenbrainz-maloja) - [Podcast downloader plugin](https://github.com/rockbox-y1/rockbox/blob/y1/INTERNET.md#podcasts) - Software Keyboard ([LeanKeyboard](https://github.com/yuliskov/LeanKeyboard)) - Implement stereo balance - Increase available memory to 256MB - Podcast Downloader optimizations - Remappings for FM Radio App - Rudimentary remaining battery time estimation - Use iPod Classic button mappings (mostly) - Feature to shutdown device with a 5s press of the center button - Function to reset bluetooth devices - Information for Taptic Engine mods - Update functionality - Enable most plugins - Enable regular db updates and autoupdate Bug Fixes: - A-B repeat - Idle shutdown/sleep timer when no music is playing - Keylock feature + advanced keylock - License viewer - runtimedb and autoresume - Battery optimization: only use wake lock when needed for sleep timers - Enable brightness settings for compatibility with existing themes + quickscreen

name: Portable Flashing Package: Rockbox-Y1 v0.3
body:
### Downloads #### Y1 · 240p

#### Y1 · 360p

--- | | | |:--:|:--:| _**Theme:** [Adwaitapod](https://github.com/rockbox-y1/themes/releases/download/for_the_gays_and_the_theys/adwaitapod_360p.zip) by [Dook](https://ko-fi.com/dook_)_ # Changelog A lot has happened since v0.2 and Rockbox on the Y1. If you are still running v0.2 you might want to consider updating. ## Major Changes - Dual Boot Stock OS/Rockbox - Type A & Type B support - use Type B if you have click wheel issues - 240p and 360p versions - Idle Poweroff, Timed Shutdown - Lyrics (lrc) support ## Improvements for Audiobooks ### Playback Speed Setting - WPS > hold Center button > Pitch - You might need to enable Timestretch in the Sound Settings first if you only see options for pitch, not speed ### Automatic Bookmarking - Enabling "Bookmark on Stop" - To stop press play 3-4 times - Or: use Timed Shutdown (General Settings > Startup/Shutdown > Start Sleep Timer) ## UI/UX - Accessibility: WPS voice announcements - Button combination to restart Rockbox if it got stuck - Enabled charging indicator - Enabled plugin to rearrange Main Menu (Plugins > Applications > main_menu_config) - Many button mapping improvements, e.g., for PictureFlow - Larger memory allocation for larger themes - App only starts when SD is ready, no Rockbox restarts necessary after copying files over or on initial boot - Battery optimizations (you may still need to recalibrate your battery after installation https://www.ifixit.com/Wiki/Battery_Calibration#Section_How_to_calibrate_your_battery) And many bug fixes and general UI/UX improvements. A big thanks to all the contributors on Github!

name: Portable Flashing Package: Rockbox-Y1 Nightly-30-03-2026
body:
### Downloads #### Y1 · Type A

#### Y1 · Type B

--- # **Please read!** This release is especially experimental and will probably cause issues. Follow the guide at the end if you want to try it. This is a full rebase on the current upstream Rockbox repository as a preparation for eventually submitting this port to the Rockbox project. For now this means the removal of very specific and rarely used features like the Apps menu. It also means simpler merges of new upstream features. 360p only, there won't be any future 240p releases. Since a lot had to change under the hood you will need to do the following: 1. Delete `.rockbox` on your SD card. 2. Full flash of the new ROM. 4. Install any of the patched themes from here: https://github.com/rockbox-y1/themes/archive/refs/heads/patch.zip 5. If you want to use any custom themes that worked for older Rockbox-Y1 versions, you will need to change paths in the theme files from `/.rockbox` to `/sdcard/.rockbox` Other changes: - fixes WPS hotkey for plugins
